title: Agents

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.body: Boot a kanade-agent service and it'll show up here within one heartbeat.

intro: Baseline liveness only — open Inventory (or click facts) for richer per-host details collected by operator-defined probes.

status.offlineTitle: No heartbeat for ≥ 2 minutes — counts as stale on the Dashboard

signing.enforcingTitle: Reports that it verifies commands and refuses the ones it cannot verify.
signing.readyTitle: Reports a keyring and no enforcement yet. Enforcement begins at this host's next agent restart — no action needed unless you want it sooner.
signing.keysOnlyTitle: Reports a keyring, but this agent version cannot say whether it enforces. Upgrade it to find out.
signing.wrongKeyTitle: Holds this backend's key id with DIFFERENT key material. It rejects everything this backend signs, and cannot recover on its own — the reload path only fires for an unknown key, and this one is known. Re-run the provisioning job, and find out how the ring got there.
signing.staleRingTitle: Holds a keyring, but not the key this backend signs with today. Normal while a rotation is still reaching the fleet; a problem if it persists, because this host rejects everything this backend sends. Re-run the provisioning job.
signing.noneTitle: Reports its keyring and holds nothing. Harmless today; this host would refuse every command the day enforcement is enabled. Run the provisioning job.
signing.unknownTitle: This agent predates keyring reporting, so nothing can be said about it. Upgrade it before provisioning — not the same as holding no keys.

columnTitles.signing: Command-signing rollout state: does this host verify who sent a command, and does it refuse when it cannot? Keys are compared against the one this backend actually signs with; when the backend is not signing there is nothing to compare against and only what each agent reports is shown.
columnTitles.rss: Agent process resident set size (current RAM footprint)
columnTitles.lastLogon: Most recent account the Windows sign-in screen used (display name over login name)

delete.confirmDescription: Removes this agent from the list now. The agents list is built from heartbeats, so if this machine is still running it will reappear on its next heartbeat (within ~30s). This only stays gone for a genuinely retired machine.

resultDialog.description: Result of the action you just ran. Close to return to the list.

sort.hint: click to sort; click again to reverse, then clear

quarantinedChipTitle: Showing only agents that rolled this version back — click to clear
